Araxxor: Necromancy

Note: a Table of Contents can be found in the pinned messages for this channel.
​
Introduction
This is an advanced guide which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in #araxxor-basic.
​
Presets and Relics
⬥ Necromancy preset 

⬥ As  Araxxor is desired, wearing a ranged weapon until Araxxor has spawned is required
⬥ It is recommended to have the NopeNopeNope perk from Player Owned Farms active
⬥ Upkeep the  buff from your familiar
⬥ Araxxor takes a few seconds to clear vulns on phase 1-3, making vuln bombs  usable on all phases
​
Top Path
Phase 1
⬥ After Araxxor has spawned, equip  + 
⬥ Apply  +  and build to 5  and 12  stacks
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do not attack the boss other than to apply the debuffs and obtain stacks
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This phase is timegated so it can be used to set yourself up for phase 2 while you deal damage
​
Phase 2
⬥ At 59 seconds use  +  +  →  +  +  →  +  + 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trigger player movement on every tick along with your mobility abilities
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Clicking on an enlarged minimap may be helpful in facilitating movement and  placements across the path
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first  +  should be executed when web burn reads 99%
​
Phase 3
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎•  +  +  →  →  
​
Middle Path
Phase 1
⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp
​
Phase 2
⬥ Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp
⬥ When you go to the top of the ramp,  → filler → 
⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline
​
Phase 3
⬥  +  + run to the edge of the arena near Phase 4 → (tc) +  →  →  →  →  → 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use  at any time in this phase
Bottom Path
Phase 1
⬥ No special setup. Just dps araxxor down to <5k hp
​
Phase 2
⬥ On Phase start  → filler → 
⬥ During the charge you want to do  +  + spam click your minimap
⬥ End this phase with at least 70% adrenaline
​
Phase 3
⬥ (tc) +  →  →  →  →  → 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use  at any time in this phase
​
Phase 4 (All Paths)
⬥  +  →  →  →  →  →  →  →  → Target  +  +  →  →  →  
​
